title: ISO/IEC 24091:2019 — Power Efficiency Measurement for Data Center Storage — Scope
text:
ISO/IEC 24091:2019 — Information technology — Power efficiency measurement specification for data center storage (based on SNIA Emerald Power Efficiency Measurement Specification V3.0.3)

Scope: Defines measurement methodologies, test protocols, and metrics for assessing power efficiency of data center storage systems. Covers online, near-online, removable media library, and virtual media library storage categories.

Purpose: Enable data center operators and storage vendors to measure and compare storage power efficiency consistently, supporting:
- Energy efficiency assessment
- Green data centre certification
- Procurement decision-making
- Environmental impact reporting
- Compliance with energy regulations

Applicable to: block access storage, file access storage, all enterprise storage tiers.

title: Data center storage power efficiency — Definitions and taxonomy
text:
ISO/IEC 24091:2019 — Clause 4: Definitions and Clause 5: Taxonomy

Key definitions:
- Power efficiency: ratio of useful work performed to energy consumed
- Active power (W): power consumed during active I/O operations
- Ready idle power (W): power consumed when system is ready but not processing I/O
- IOps: I/O operations per second (throughput metric)
- Bandwidth (MB/s): data transfer rate
- SPECsfs: Standard Performance Evaluation Corporation Storage File System benchmark
- SPEC SFS 2014: benchmark for file access storage performance
- Vdbench: I/O workload generator
- RAS (Reliability, Availability, Serviceability): storage system resilience attributes
- COM (Capacity Optimisation Mode): storage compression/deduplication

Taxonomy categories (Clause 5):
- Online: continuously spinning disk, immediate access (e.g. SAN, NAS)
- Near-Online: slower access, lower power when idle (e.g. SATA nearline)
- Removable Media Library: tape libraries and optical jukebox systems
- Virtual Media Library: software-defined tape emulation

Taxonomy classifications: based on primary storage function, access latency, and drive technology.

title: Data center storage power efficiency — Test methodology and metrics
text:
ISO/IEC 24091:2019 — Clauses 7-8: Test definition and metrics

Test methodology:
- Pre-conditioning: stable state achieved before measurement
- Conditioning phase: workload applied to reach steady state
- Active test phase: measurement during sustained workload
- Ready idle test: measurement at zero I/O load

Test types by access method:
7.3 Block access online and near-online tests: sequential and random read/write patterns
7.4 File access online and near-online tests: NFS/CIFS workload profiles
7.5 Block and file access ready idle test: power at minimum activity
7.6 Capacity optimization test: power during compression/deduplication
7.7 Removable media library testing: tape library robot activity included
7.8 Virtual media library testing: software emulation power profiles

Primary metrics (Clause 8):
- Online/near-online: SPECsfs2014 IOps/W or MB/s/W
- Power Efficiency (Active Block): IOps/W during block access workload
- Power Efficiency (Active File): MB/s/W during file access workload
- Power Efficiency (Ready Idle): W at idle (lower is better)
- Removable media library: GB transferred per Watt
- Virtual media library: emulated tape operations per Watt

Disclosure requirements (Clause 9): product identification, test metrics, test characterization, full configuration description.
